hypothesis: Retain the confirmed Round 10 frontier and fuse each affine-free LayerNorm with its resolved scale-shift modulation by compile-time specializing the repository Triton select01 LayerNorm kernel without selection or gate output.

source_contract.original_formula: layer_norm(x, weight=None, bias=None, eps=1e-6) * (1 + scale) + shift
source_contract.candidate_formula: the same affine-free FP32 LayerNorm statistics and eps, followed in the same Triton program by x_hat * (1 + scale) + shift and one BF16 output store

compile_time_specialization.effect: Index, alternate branch, gate loads, and gate output store are dead code; only scale0 and shift0 are read. Existing select01 callers set both flags true and retain their previous behavior.

source_contract.off_path: SGLANG_SANA_NORM_MODULATION_FUSION defaults to 0. When off, the exact prior Round 10 LayerNorm plus optional fuse_scale_shift path executes unchanged.
site_coverage: norm1 plus scale_msa and shift_msa before linear self-attention
norm2 plus scale_mlp and shift_mlp before GLUMBTempConv
source_contract.first_block_layout: The patch embedding produces a [1,32760,2240] last-dimension-strided view. The enabled path makes one explicit contiguous copy before the first block's fused kernel; later residual outputs are contiguous. The exact strided boundary is separately benchmarked and validated.

formal_gate.existing_select01_regression: The exact formal unspecialized select01 path was rerun after specialization; output/gate equivalence and timing passed with SELECT01=True and WRITE_GATE=True.

rounding_contract.explanation: The LayerNorm and modulation formulas, FP32 reduction/statistics, BF16 model contract, and eps are unchanged. Combining primitive boundaries changes BF16 store/reload rounding, admitted as kernel fusion ordering; formal max absolute BF16 delta is 0.125.

warmup_accounting: The exact Triton specialization was compiled by the bounded probe into the shared persistent cache. The formal worker still performs its configured one-step model warmup and the frozen outer total remains the selection metric; internal warmup and denoising stages are supporting evidence only.
